interpretation: Lineage-specific trait-memory rankings are not detectably organized as a smooth function of deep family phylogeny on the cleaned log scale. Related families do not consistently retain more similar conservative-to-labile rank profiles. Together with the near-half pair-order reversal result, the ranking architecture is better described as phylogenetically mosaic at this resolution than as a deeply inherited family hierarchy.
hard_nonclaims: A null deep-phylogeny association does not imply that ranking profiles are evolutionarily random.
This exploratory result does not identify the ecological or genetic driver of re-ranking.
The weak raw prune-only tendency is not robust to the primary log-scale analysis or the S3 tree.
